user.title: Anchor server
user.description: Enter the address you open Anchor with in the browser. Notes are added afterwards on the integration page.

error.cannot_connect: No Anchor server answered at this URL.

abort.already_configured: This Anchor server is already set up.

user.title: Anchor user
user.description: Create an API token in Anchor under Settings and paste it here.

note.title: Pick a note
note.description: Every checkbox line of the note becomes a to-do item. All other lines stay untouched.

reconfigure.title: Change API token
reconfigure.description: Paste a new API token for the note “{note}”, for example after it was regenerated in Anchor.

error.cannot_connect: The Anchor server is not reachable.
error.no_notes: This user has no notes they can edit that aren't added yet.
error.no_checkboxes: This note has no checkbox lines. Pick another one or add a checkbox in Anchor first.
error.note_not_accessible: This token's user can't edit this note.

invalid_token.title: Anchor rejected the API token of the note “{note}”
invalid_token.description: The token was probably regenerated or revoked in Anchor. Open the Anchor integration, select ⋮ next to the note “{note}”, choose **Change API token** and paste a current token. All notes of the same user get the new token.
